response.sql:
WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    trans.account_id,
    account.frequency,
    AVG(trans.amount) as account_avg
  FROM trans
  JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
  GROUP BY trans.account_id, account.frequency
),
freq_means AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(account_avg) as freq_mean
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  account_avgs.account_id,
  account_avgs.frequency,
  account_avgs.account_avg,
  account_avgs.account_avg / freq_means.freq_mean as ratio
FROM account_avgs
JOIN freq_means ON account_avgs.frequency = freq_means.frequency
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: "Average transaction amount" uses trans.amount as stored (unsigned), without sign adjustment by trans.type. This interprets "transaction amount" as magnitude rather than net/signed flow.

alternatives.interpretation: If amounts should be signed based on transaction type (PRIJEM = positive, VYDAJ = negative, others unsigned), multiply amounts by sign before averaging.
alternatives.sql:
WITH account_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    trans.account_id,
    account.frequency,
    AVG(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount
             WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount
             ELSE trans.amount
        END) as account_avg
  FROM trans
  JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
  GROUP BY trans.account_id, account.frequency
),
freq_means AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(account_avg) as freq_mean
  FROM account_avgs
  GROUP BY frequency
)
SELECT 
  account_avgs.account_id,
  account_avgs.frequency,
  account_avgs.account_avg,
  account_avgs.account_avg / freq_means.freq_mean as ratio
FROM account_avgs
JOIN freq_means ON account_avgs.frequency = freq_means.frequency
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
